assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a wide transparent game logo reading exactly "Doll Puppets", and no other text. Replace horse and horseshoe motifs with a wooden marionette crossbar at the top and strings leading to letters, a subtle theatre curtain swag. Wide 1100:420 composition, all artwork inside frame with small clear padding. Clean actual alpha, no background or checkerboard. Big readable lettering for young children.

Use case: illustration-story. Wide panoramic 3:1 title screen game art. Farm hills, trees, fence, barn glimpsed in the side bleed. Centre stage empty and fairly plain, no characters, no text, no logo. Logo will overlay top third and portraits bottom 35 percent, so preserve calm broad central negative space. Important theatre content inside central 1280-wide area of 2172x724 canvas; far left and right are scenic bleed. Child friendly polished painterly scenery matching reference.

Actual alpha background. Ignore corrupt green/magenta fringe and horizontal artifacts in references; do not reproduce them. No lettering.
